blind.second_guess: pile of gold coins with treasure
blind.description: A low, roughly circular mound of gold coins filled with various treasures. Submerged and resting in the hoard are two wooden treasure chests with iron reinforcement bands (one open revealing coins inside, one closed), two golden urns or vases, an upturned round shield, several daggers thrust blade-first into the coins, and scattered faceted red and green gemstones. The surfaces are stylized and continuous, with items naturally partially submerged into the coin pile. The underside rests flat against the ground.
blind.from_above: A circular textured gold disc resembling a pile of coins, studded with red and green gems, two treasure chests, two gold jugs, a round shield, and sword/dagger pommels pointing upwards.
blind.height_vs_figure: Height is about 0.35 times the figure's height (around 2 ft / 0.6 m tall at the peak of the chest), with a circular footprint roughly 0.75 times the figure's height in diameter (about 4.3 ft / 1.3 m wide).
